task_metadata.research_topic: LLM agent tool-use reasoning strategies and search policies
task_metadata.research_question: How can search and backtracking strategies improve the success and efficiency of tool-using LLM agents?

tests.label: I1-instruction-deepseek
tests.notes: StableToolBench I1-instruction subset; agent backend = deepseek-chat via DeepSeek official API.

tests.label: I1-instruction-qwen72b
tests.notes: StableToolBench I1-instruction subset; agent backend = qwen2.5-72b-instruct via Dashscope.

tests.label: I1-instruction-qwen7b
tests.notes: StableToolBench I1-instruction subset; agent backend = qwen2.5-7b-instruct via Dashscope.

baselines.name: greedy_chain
baselines.notes: Sequential CoT-style rollout with no backtracking; the task scaffold notes this is CoT@1-like.

baselines.name: dfs_ranked
baselines.notes: Best-first DFS with LLM ranking and backtracking, matching the task's StableToolBench-style DFS-with-filter variant.

baselines.name: dfsdt
baselines.notes: Depth-first tree search without ranking; the task scaffold calls this DFSDT / with_filter=False.
